I had two alcohol rehab experiences in the past, which were obviously not successful.

My experience at The Hills has been different and extremely positive.

After the initial alcohol detoxification during which I was constantly monitored, the rehab treatment started, addressing the core issues, deep healing and dynamic personal transformation.

The therapist assigned to me has been absolutely fantastic and really help me to clarify my problems, prioritise and coping mechanisms.

During my stay, I engaged in yoga, swimming, sport in a very well equipped gym, sound healing and mindfulness.

Before my departure, the therapist and I review all strategies and tools to prevent a relapse.

Staff are very professional, kind and efficient.

The facilities and food at The Hills are what you would expect in a 5 star hotel.

I strongly recommend The Hills to anyone in need, just don’t forgot your swimming goggles like I did (lol).👍👍👍❤️❤️

Ive been to a view rehabs before, but the hills is it ! Never had such good counseling in my life, the whole counselor team icl the support staff are amazing. They work with passion and you feel it whole around the hills, they give me my life back and way more . I will be for ever grateful to the hills for changing my life and the life of my family. Thank you for ever, the hills will have a place in my heart for the rest of my life. And i will be back not as cliënt but as staff!!!

Recommendable, extra attention to each individual, holistic side of the program was sound, also physical side of program was great, amazing gym facilities and pools second to none,  good variety of age groups in the community. Also flexible with your program by allowing clients to add extra massages, holistic programs, outings etc was very helpful filling up my program.

Support staff:
Anwar and Jay made it a special experience

Bailarn and stamp easy to talk to and always helpful

The Hills Rehab Chiang Mai - My true experience:

Start with the cons
≠ 24/7 Internet is a joke. Don't even have 24/7 electricity. Often goes off for hours at night, so good luck if you have sleep problems.
≠ Meds costs you won't know about till your there. So it is more money than they will tell you before you get there. Lots more.
≠ Doctor is incompetent to the point of danger (good if you need a soft detox) but you could tell him anything and he don't check nothing.
≠ No female councillor. So if you want that then maybe find somewhere that has the most basic requirement for women.
≠ Single rooms only and cameras don't seem work so you can imagine what's going on.
≠ Staff either are willfully blind or they just don't know what's going on.
≠ Never trust anything with all 5* reviews. That's a sure sign of somethings untrustworthy.

Pros
≠ Support staff, nursing staff & kitchen staff work the hardest (give them a raise Tonburi/ Manta Group)
≠ One of the counselors is good in session, very perceptive.
≠ it looks very nice, nice pools etc. Lots of abandoned buildings, great urban exploring.

Conclusion

If you can or want to pay for luxury then go for it. If you want recovery then I'd keep searching. As a UK national I'd say its soft compared to any UK detox/rehab. I will never be happy about hidden medical costs. And it's difficult if you have concerns about the place to speak to Board of Directors. A simple request in the West. So before you spend your money know it will cost you more than expected. I just don't wanna see any more family's lied to.

I have been to psychiatric units and rehabs over the world and my praise isn't easily earned.

I can say with warm sincerity this sets the standard when it comes to rehabs.

Especially as the price comparison with the UK and US

I choose very wisely these days  and was extremely hesitant to stray from Engalnd after a horrifying experience ce with a well know outfit in South Africa.

The Hills was personally recommended and I phoned Peter directly. He gave me all the reassurance I needed with his honesty and candour, and I gor to talk to the psychiatrist about a potentially difficult prescription med taper.

Luxury, food and shouldnt be the impetus to go to a rehab. Yet it helps. As for the money  it's utterly ridiculous how such a beautiful place, sublime amenities, and all that can exist.

More imlortantly the one on one therapy sessions were very good. I am complicated but was given great help and perspective  by my therapist.

What was new to me and something i have repeatedly shunned was the holistic aspect of recovery. Craig, a therapist, recommended a book “ the body keeps score” and thats where massage, tension release exercise, personal training, kickboxing, reiki  sound healing, chats with monks and walks, excursions in nature as varied as white water rafting to waterfall hikes to thai cooking all have a part to play.

Obviously they also have classes on the evidence based psychological techniques. I would have prefered these to be less lecture type though.

I was happy to be in a group that was diverse but shared the common goal of wanting to get better, a given prerequisite one would think. And the community supportive and the surrounding, acres of apace, pools, open air

Indeed it is not high security, so it also requires personal accountability and one wanting to get better. Although providing a safe, secure place to do so. If one wants to self sabotage and cause issues a more secure unit may be for yiu.

And when I say safe, I also include the fact for such a facility it also has 24 hour trained nursing Staff, Physican and psychiatrist there daily and a hospital nearby. Which isn't always the standard.

Overall, what i found stood out the most, was how they treated people with humanity and respect. Often not the case in rehabs

The Hill is the most amazing rehab if you want to change your life. Not only is the property astonishing and very well maintained, the support staff takes Thai hospitality to the utmost level of care and attention to detail. I am lost for words.

The program is very well designed for clients of all needs and specified and personalised for each client to guarantee the best result. I worked with Yuri Cardozo, a clinical psychologist and trauma expert. She has absolutely gotten to the route of my problems and transformed my life. Dr. Suttipan has gone over and beyond to fix my prescriptions which have made such a great difference to my overall mental health.

The Hills cares for their clients to another level. I have never been taken care of in such an attentive way. They genuinely want to help you get better. I cannot recommend this rehab enough.

I am so thankful.
This place was great.  Accommodations were top notch.    Ahmed was my counsellor during my stay. …

I have recommended my friend to seek drug treatment and rehabilitation here. It took about 2 months and after he came out I immediately knew that my friend was living a happier life and had much better spirits. He was able to look at the world more positively than before.
I feel glad for him.

The hills is a beautiful place and has a holistic approach to physical and mental detox . Calming , soothing and takes you back to yourself . The staff is the most helpful , Yumm food …and the therapists are amazing .

When arriving at the hills I was very poorly and I was in a lot of pain. I didn't want to participate but after getting through the withdrawals I was taking part in everything and doing as much as possible. The support staff are amazing and will help you with your needs, and make sure your feeling okay and help you to your therapy sessions. This is the same with the therapists and counselors . All the hills staff care and just want whats best for you.

I didn't want to do rehab or have therapy but I'm glad I did because the way things where going before i was seriously ill and in a dark place. They helped me over come all that and give me the tools to carry on with a healthy life. I couldn't be more grateful and would recommend it to any one.

My time at The Hills was a very positive and life-changing experience. The facility itself is beautiful, peaceful, and provided the perfect environment to focus on recovery and personal growth. The staff were beyond supportive, caring, and genuinely invested in my recovery, with 24 hour health care. Through CBT, DBT, relapse prevention, group therapy, and step work, I gained a better understanding of myself, my addiction, and the tools I need to maintain my recovery. I am grateful for everything I learned and would highly recommend The Hills to anyone seeking help with addiction and building a better future!
I came to the hills because I needed help with my depression and anxiety issues, not as an addict, and can highly recommend this experience to other people who suffer from similar problems. …
